content.title: RBC Heritage 2027 Packages - Guaranteed Tickets & Packages
content.text: The RBC Heritage isn’t just about world-class golf, it’s also one of the PGA TOUR’s most enjoyable spectator experiences, with a range of hospitality options designed to suit every type of fan. From relaxed viewing areas to premium, all-inclusive venues, there’s something for everyone looking to elevate their tournament experience at Harbour Town Golf Links. Whether you’re attending for a single day or the full week, each package offers its own unique way to soak up the action, with a variety of ticket options available: Ultimate Patron Pass: The all-access option, offering entry to multiple hospitality venues including the Calibogue Club, Lighthouse Club and Doc’s BBQ at 15 Calibogue Club: An all-inclusive hospitality venue located between the 17th green and 18th tee, with an additional viewing area at the 8th green Lighthouse Club: A premium two-storey, open-air skybox overlooking the iconic 18th green, offering one of the best views on the PGA TOUR Doc’s BBQ: A lively hospitality setting just behind the 15th green, putting you right on top of the action Heritage Lawn Club: A newer private venue with views of the Calibogue Sound, 18th tee and Heritage Lawn Grounds Ticket: General admission access with the freedom to explore the course and enjoy rope-line views Grounds Package: A multi-day option including grounds access for all six days of the tournament Practice Round Tickets: Single-day access to enjoy a more relaxed atmosphere, including opening ceremonies or the pro-am For those seeking a more social and lively atmosphere, shared hospitality venues provide excellent course views alongside food and beverage options, making them perfect for groups or clients. These spaces strike a balance between comfort and flexibility, allowing you to move around while still having a premium base to return to. At the higher end, private hospitality suites deliver a more exclusive experience. Positioned in prime locations around the course, these offer unrivalled views, upscale dining and a more intimate setting, ideal for entertaining guests or enjoying the tournament in style. There are also upgraded ticket options that include access to premium viewing decks and shaded lounges, giving fans a step up from general admission without committing to full hospitality. It’s a great way to enjoy added comfort while still being close to the action. No matter which option you choose, RBC Heritage hospitality is built around Southern charm, great food and unforgettable golf, ensuring your time at Hilton Head is about far more than just what happens inside the ropes.
